job.primary.label: Primary workflow
job.primary.value: Live dictation, durable personal capture, and voice input for your own tools and agents.
job.primary.outcome: Speak into an app now without throwing the capture away afterward.
job.primary.privacyBoundary: Core recognition can run on-device; optional sync and configured providers have separate boundaries.

evidence.locator: Voice, Capture, and Automation command groups

job.primary.editorialNote: Do not position Talkie as a meeting bot, batch transcription suite, or accessibility controller.

capture.live_dictation.label: Live dictation
capture.live_dictation.value: Hold-to-talk dictation with text returned to the active app.
capture.live_dictation.privacyBoundary: Audio is handled by the selected recognition engine.

capture.voice_memos.label: Voice memos
capture.voice_memos.value: Recorded memos retain audio, transcript, and derived results such as summaries or tasks.
capture.voice_memos.outcome: Keep spoken thinking as a revisitable object, not only pasted text.
capture.voice_memos.privacyBoundary: Stored locally with optional sync paths.

capture.visual_context.label: Visual context
capture.visual_context.value: Screenshots, selected regions, short screen clips, and camera captures can accompany spoken context.
capture.visual_context.outcome: Show an agent what you mean instead of describing the screen from memory.
capture.visual_context.privacyBoundary: Captured media is stored with the local Talkie data; downstream workflows may add their own boundary.

capture.ocr.label: OCR on captures
capture.ocr.value: Captured screenshots can expose recognized text alongside the media.
capture.ocr.outcome: Search or route what was visible without manually retyping it.

capture.file_transcription.label: Audio and video files
capture.file_transcription.value: Talkie retains recordings it captures, but it is not substantiated as a batch audio/video transcription suite.
capture.file_transcription.outcome: Choose a dedicated file transcriber for large media backlogs, subtitles, and watch folders.
capture.file_transcription.privacyBoundary: Not applicable to an unsupported workflow claim.
capture.file_transcription.editorialNote: Do not turn the absence of a batch workflow into a negative on pages where file transcription is the competitor's whole category.

capture.remote_desktop.label: Locked-down app delivery
capture.remote_desktop.value: Normal active-app insertion; no substantiated Citrix/RDP/VMware keystroke-injection mode.
capture.remote_desktop.outcome: Not the fit for environments where clipboard delivery is blocked.

capture.meetings.label: Meeting capture
capture.meetings.value: Personal recording and dictation, not an automatic attendee for Zoom, Meet, or Teams.
capture.meetings.outcome: Use a meeting assistant when the job is to join calls and create a shared record.

processing.locus.label: Core speech processing
processing.locus.value: Core speech recognition runs on-device. iCloud sync and optional user-configured AI providers are separate, opt-in data paths.
processing.locus.outcome: Dictate offline while retaining a clear boundary around features that do use a service.
processing.locus.privacyBoundary: On-device for core ASR; CloudKit for enabled sync; third-party boundary only for configured AI workflows.
processing.locus.editorialNote: Never collapse processing, sync, and workflow-provider boundaries into the phrase 'everything stays on-device.'

processing.models.label: Recognition engines
processing.models.value: Selectable local Parakeet and Whisper models on Mac, with Apple Speech and Parakeet paths on iOS.
processing.models.outcome: Choose a local engine for the hardware and capture path instead of being locked to one model.
processing.models.editorialNote: This corrects the current comparison copy that describes Talkie as a fixed Parakeet-on-Mac / Apple-Speech-on-iOS system.

processing.languages.label: Language coverage
processing.languages.value: Varies by the selected local engine; no stable public language count is substantiated in the repository.
processing.languages.outcome: Buyers should verify their language in the app rather than rely on a marketing total.
processing.languages.editorialNote: Do not publish a Talkie language count, accuracy percentage, or words-per-minute claim without a dated benchmark.

output.transcript_style.label: Default output
output.transcript_style.value: Capture-first transcription that stays relatively close to what was said; additional transformations are explicit workflows.
output.transcript_style.outcome: Preserve the source capture while choosing when to transform it.
output.transcript_style.privacyBoundary: Depends on the selected transformation; core transcript remains local.

output.dictionary.label: Custom vocabulary
output.dictionary.value: Dictionary architecture is implemented in parts but remains draft/spec territory as a product claim.
output.dictionary.outcome: Not yet safe to promise as a published differentiator.
output.dictionary.editorialNote: Keep this out of public matrices until the shipped product state is confirmed.

output.context_awareness.label: Context awareness
output.context_awareness.value: Context is attached deliberately through app metadata, screenshots, regions, clips, or camera capture; Talkie does not claim continuous screen-reading for every dictation.
output.context_awareness.outcome: Choose when visual context is part of a capture instead of granting blanket screen access.
output.context_awareness.privacyBoundary: User-initiated local capture; downstream agent boundaries remain separate.

output.diarization.label: Speaker separation
output.diarization.outcome: Use a meeting or media transcription tool when named speakers are required.

output.meeting_intelligence.label: Meeting intelligence
output.meeting_intelligence.value: Workflows can summarize personal captures, but Talkie does not provide a meeting-native summary, speaker, and action-item system.
output.meeting_intelligence.outcome: Personal automation is available; team meeting intelligence is not the product's job.

data.store.label: Capture record
data.store.value: A structured local capture library backed by Core Data/SQLite-compatible stores rather than a transient paste buffer.
data.store.outcome: Search and reuse previous dictations, memos, and media.
data.store.privacyBoundary: Local by default; enabled iCloud sync uses CloudKit.
data.store.editorialNote: Say 'structured local library' publicly; 'local SQLite database' is too implementation-specific for every app surface.

data.search.label: Search and filters
data.search.value: Full-text search with filters for source, type, app, time, attached media, summaries, tasks, audio, and segments.
data.search.outcome: Retrieve a spoken capture by meaning and context instead of remembering where it was pasted.

data.sync.label: Device continuity
data.sync.value: Optional iCloud/CloudKit sync across Apple devices, plus paired-device bridge paths for local network or Tailscale setups.
data.sync.outcome: Capture on one Apple device and continue from another.
data.sync.privacyBoundary: CloudKit uses Apple infrastructure; paired-device paths use authenticated LAN/Tailscale connections.

data.portability.label: Portability
data.portability.value: CLI access, JSON and path output, plus archive, clean, and data-path commands.
data.portability.outcome: Move captures into scripts or backups without scraping the UI.
data.portability.privacyBoundary: Local filesystem and stdout unless the user routes output elsewhere.

automation.cli.label: Command-line access
automation.cli.value: The `@talkie/cli` package queries dictations, memos, media, search results, workflows, devices, and data paths.
automation.cli.outcome: Treat voice captures as inputs to tools rather than content trapped in an app.
automation.cli.privacyBoundary: Reads local data; invoked commands determine any downstream boundary.

automation.sdk_api.label: SDK and API
automation.sdk_api.value: A TypeScript client package and local gateway/bridge APIs expose Talkie to custom integrations.
automation.sdk_api.outcome: Build against Talkie without automating its UI.
automation.sdk_api.privacyBoundary: Depends on the configured gateway and integration.

automation.workflows.label: Workflow engine
automation.workflows.value: Captured speech and context can enter Talkie workflows with durable run history and explicit actions.
automation.workflows.outcome: Turn a capture into a repeatable process instead of a one-off paste.
automation.workflows.privacyBoundary: Each action/provider has its own declared boundary.

automation.agents.label: Agent input
automation.agents.value: Dictations and visual context can be routed into agentic terminals such as Claude Code.
automation.agents.outcome: Use voice plus the current screen as an instruction package for an agent.
automation.agents.privacyBoundary: Local capture first; the chosen agent or model has a separate boundary.

automation.integrations.label: Integration style
automation.integrations.value: CLI, SDK, gateway, webhooks, and configurable workflows for building your own path; not a catalog of meeting/CRM connectors.
automation.integrations.outcome: Compose a local or developer-owned workflow instead of adopting a vendor's collaboration stack.
automation.integrations.privacyBoundary: Each configured integration declares its own boundary.

automation.scripting.label: Scripting model
automation.scripting.value: External CLI, TypeScript SDK, JSON, gateway APIs, and workflow definitions operate on captured data.
automation.scripting.outcome: Automate around durable capture objects without learning a voice-command grammar.

reach.platforms.label: Supported platforms
reach.platforms.value: Apple-focused: macOS, iPhone/iPad surfaces, and Apple Watch capture.
reach.platforms.outcome: Deep Apple-device continuity, with no Windows, Android, or Linux client claim.

collaboration.meetings.label: Meeting workflow
collaboration.meetings.value: Not a meeting bot or shared meeting workspace.
collaboration.meetings.outcome: Use Talkie for personal capture; choose a meeting product for automatic call attendance and team records.
collaboration.meetings.editorialNote: A deliberate category boundary, not a missing checkbox to score against every competitor.

collaboration.voice_control.label: Hands-free computer control
collaboration.voice_control.value: Dictation-focused; not a complete cursor, click, grammar, or accessibility control layer.
collaboration.voice_control.outcome: Use a dedicated accessibility/voice-control product when full hands-free operation is required.

collaboration.teams.label: Team administration
collaboration.teams.value: Personal capture product; no substantiated shared dictionaries, shared snippets, usage dashboards, or enterprise admin layer.
collaboration.teams.outcome: Best evaluated as an individual tool rather than a centrally managed team writing system.
